description: Extends a comma list value then replaces the DNS line. DISTILL-CANARY-161f83ce

files.net/wg.ini:
[Interface]
Address = 10.8.0.2/24
DNS = 1.1.1.1

[Peer]
Endpoint = vpn.orchid.example:51820
AllowedIPs = 10.8.0.0/24
PersistentKeepalive = 25

turns.prompt: net/wg.ini 的 AllowedIPs 追加一个网段 192.168.50.0/24，用逗号加空格接在后面。
再把 DNS 换成 10.8.0.1。然后读回文件确认两处都对，告诉我这两行现在的样子。

net/wg.ini.equals:
[Interface]
Address = 10.8.0.2/24
DNS = 10.8.0.1

[Peer]
Endpoint = vpn.orchid.example:51820
AllowedIPs = 10.8.0.0/24, 192.168.50.0/24
PersistentKeepalive = 25
